prompts.purpose: Minimal probe sent to an AI provider to verify authentication and model availability. Contains no user data.
prompts.inputPolicy: No user-supplied data. Static system instruction and static user message only.
prompts.outputPolicy: Accept only {ok: true} JSON. Any other response is rejected as schema validation failure.
injectionDefenses: No user-supplied content in prompt — injection surface is zero
skipResponseFormat enabled to avoid provider-side wrapping confusion
Zod z.literal(true) enforces exact output shape; {ok: false} or extra fields cause AI_SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED
Response size capped at 20 tokens max

prompts.purpose: Generate candidate clip segments from timestamped transcripts.
prompts.inputPolicy: Accept sanitized transcript chunks and bounded metadata only.
prompts.outputPolicy: Return structured, schema-validated candidate ranges with rationale.
injectionDefenses: Treat transcript text as untrusted data
No tool execution instructions from transcript content

prompts.purpose: Summarize why clip candidates were proposed for human review.
prompts.inputPolicy: Use candidate metadata and transcript excerpts without secrets.
injectionDefenses: No direct instruction following from user-generated transcript
